# Challenger House

> Organisational Architects for the AI transition. AI doesn't transform your organisation, it reveals it. We rebuild what it reveals, starting with one day on your real work.

Challenger House helps CEOs and leadership teams get real ROI from AI by treating adoption as organisational development, not a tool rollout. The first wave of AI (licences, productivity demos) is over; the hard part is that AI runs on how your organisation actually works, and most of that was never written down. What AI reveals first is the "missing middle": who checks the output, who decides when the machine and the expert disagree, who is accountable for the learning loops. No org chart shows it and no licence builds it. That is the part we build.

We are three operators (Marcus Druen, André Cramer, Brittney Bean) with three decades of organisational development, facilitation and venture building, now turned on the AI transition. We spark courage to act now.

## The offer (one hour, one day, one quarter)

- [The 1-Day Executive Experience](https://challenger-house.com/experience.html): A strategic working day with your leadership team on your real value stream, with frontier AI live in the room. Two reveals on a single value stream, a structural one and a human one. You leave with the courage to lead AI adoption as the adaptive challenge it is, the business case to go beyond Copilot, and greater sovereignty over the machine.
- [The Sprint](https://challenger-house.com/sprint.html): One quarter. Three months of work wrapped around a three-day Residency, so capability and results compound and the new way of working survives Monday. Outputs include the Org Mirror, tailored instruments, and board-ready artefacts.
- Free 1:1 AI coaching (the Drawing Board) or a team Walkthrough: your first hour, at no cost, to feel the frontier on your own work.
